user.title: Klimaplan
user.description: Cooling schedules and heat protection for air conditioners. All values can be changed later under Configure.

data.block_entity: Block cooling while on (optional, e.g. heating season)
data.motion_entities: Motion / presence sensors (someone was home today)

data_description.outside_entity: Outdoor temperature. Once above the limit today, the hot day lasts until midnight.
data_description.persons: If one of these persons was home today, the day counts as occupied (no vacation). Optionally schedules can also require someone home right now.
data_description.motion_entities: Alternative to persons: enough different sensors triggered today also count as occupied.
data_description.vacation_entity: Optional. While on, no automatic cooling.
data_description.block_entity: Optional. While on (e.g. heating season), no automatic cooling. Manual control always works.
data_description.forecast_entity: If today's forecast high is above the limit, the hot day starts in the morning.
